panels.title: Top tools by bytes (avg per request)

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, round(avg(bytes)) AS avg_bytes FROM claude.requests ARRAY JOIN tools.name AS name, tools.bytes AS bytes WHERE ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime GROUP BY name ORDER BY avg_bytes DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 5 minute) AS time, sum(cache_read_tokens) / greatest(sum(input_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens), 1) AS cache_hit_rate FROM claude.requests WHERE ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 5 minute) AS time, avg(system_bytes) AS system_prompt, avg(tools_bytes) AS tool_definitions, avg(total_bytes - system_bytes - tools_bytes) AS messages_and_rest FROM claude.requests WHERE ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT ts, model, length(tools.name) AS tool_count, tools_bytes, total_bytes, message_count FROM claude.requests WHERE ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20
